_doc: NONASK-1103 I-A6 D5 (A6-W): static labels and notes for vera/web_route.py, the inline answer-only web route. No new thresholds.
_fetch_cap_note: At most one fetch per host per call (one round), redirect hops included (a hop to a host already fetched is refused before it is sent). Further candidates on the same host are listed only, never fetched. Fetches started count against the per-prompt document bound (bounds.max_docs_per_prompt via acq_config.inline_fresh_docs, passed by the inline caller); no separate web cap. Before each fetch the stop/disconnect signal (streamed) or the non-stream deadline less per_doc_timeout_s is checked; once either trips, the rest are listed only (read_stopped / read_deadline / read_fetch_budget).
_crawl_delay_note: Robots Crawl-delay (VERA-DAR UA, else * group) is enforced in vera.public_fetch via a per-host in-process table (vera.selective_fetch.crawl_reserve); an early request is refused as crawl_delay and listed here (read_crawl_delay), never sent early.
_hop_gate_note: WP6-P2b S1 (R-050): every hop (first URL and each redirect target) passes source_permissions.read_gate (deny list, registry access_verdict forbid / terms links_only) and the login_path_markers URL heuristic inside public_fetch BEFORE robots.txt or the page is requested for that hop.
_calibration_note: login_path_markers (pre-request URL-path heuristic, same status: uncalibrated, discard-only; a hit lists the page as read_login_paywall without a request, a miss changes nothing) and login_markers is an uncalibrated, discard-only heuristic (a hit drops the page text and lists the page; a miss changes nothing). marker_scan_chars bounds the scan; it is a safety bound, not a decision threshold. Accepted by the orchestrator 2026-11-04 as a CONSERVATIVE SKIP: measured on no real pages (synthetic fixtures only); false positives only drop a page to the reading list, false negatives are bounded by the read gate and public_fetch. Calibrate from owner-run dev traces (pages skipped as read_login_paywall vs. readable) before adding or removing markers.
_role_note: Role: pure and request-local. Reads only through vera.public_fetch after the READ gate. Page text is held in memory only; this module calls no store, cache, queue or logger with page text. Ingest is always False in this work package.
label: web source
disclosure: Public web pages found by search may be read to answer your question; they are not saved.
login_markers: create a free account to continue

phrases.host_round_cap: not read: only one page per site is read per answer
phrases.fetch_failed: not read: the page could not be read
phrases.crawl_delay: not read yet: the site asks readers to wait between visits
phrases.empty: not read: the page had no readable text
phrases.deadline: not read: there was not enough time left to read it for this answer
phrases.stopped: not read: the request was stopped before it was read
phrases.fetch_budget: not read: the limit of documents read per question was reached
phrases.ingest_answer_only: not stored: web pages are used for this answer only
